The <b>Silk Soar</b> is an [[Abilities (Silksong)|Ability]] that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] acquires in [[Act 3]] of <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Hornet flings her [[Needle]] into the sky on a thread of [[Silk]], then rockets up to where the Needle sticks. It costs 1 strand of Silk per use.

== Function ==
* Hold DOWN + HARPOON to begin charging the Silk Soar. Hornet can cancel the charge early without expending Silk.
* After about a second, release to have Hornet throw her Needle.
* When the Needle hits the nearest ceiling, Hornet shoots up to it.
** Higher ceilings create more of a delay between throw and jump.
** Hornet's flight can be cancelled early by pressing JUMP, ATTACK, HARPOON, or by being attacked.
** The Needle can pass through room transitions, and will bring Hornet through them as long as it eventually hits a ceiling
=== Damage ===
* Silk Soar is not very useful for combat purposes, but it does deal damage to enemies. 
** When the thrown Needle hits an enemy, it deals the normal damage of the Needle.
** If Hornet subsequently hits an enemy, it deals 5 damage, regardless of the level of the Needle. Hornet will still take contact damage with the enemy if it is not killed.
** Both hitting the enemy with the Needle and making contact with the enemy give [[Silk]], resulting in 1 extra silk than was started with before the Silk Soar if both hits land.
** Both parts of the damage are affected by enemy damage modifiers.
** Both parts of the damage increase the Focus of the [[Hunter Crest]] and are affected by its multiplier. The second hit deals 5, 6, and 8 damage at Focus level 0, 1, and 2 respectively.
*** If Hornet takes damage however, this Focus is instantly reset regardless.
** Neither part of the damage is affected by the [[Beast Crest]] [[Bind]].
** Neither part of the damage counts as attacking for the purposes of the Beast Crest Bind, unlike the [[Clawline]]. However, taking damage by contacting an enemy will count as damage for reducing the duration of the Bind.
** Neither part has its damage increased by the [[Snitch Pick]].

== How to Acquire ==
Silk Soar is one of the last Abilities Hornet acquires, only being obtainable in [[Act 3]]. It can be found on her first visit to [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]], in a [[Weaver Burial Spire]] behind a [[Needolin]] door in [[Weavenest Absolom]].

== Trivia ==
* The Abyss and subsequent escape sequence back up to [[Deep Docks]] contain several broken or unusable [[Weavers|Weaver]] lifts similar to the one in [[Weavenest Atla]]. These indicate where Silk Soar can be used to go up.

* It is possible to travel all the way from the bottom of [[Moss Grotto]] up to the top of the [[Blasted Steps]] using a single Silk Soar.
